name: EcaTranslator Lite
author: Ray Rahman

sections.description:
EcaTranslator Lite is a lightweight and user-friendly plugin that allows you to translate posts, pages, and custom post types directly from your WordPress admin panel.

Key Features:

  • Translate posts and pages with one click.
  • Uses OpenAi for translation.
  • Simple frontend language switching.
  • Optimized for performance and lightweight.

Perfect for bloggers, business websites, or anyone looking to reach a global audience.

External services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API (ChatGPT) to generate AI-based responses and translations. This functionality is essential to provide AI-powered language generation and processing features within the plugin.

The plugin sends user-provided prompts or text input to OpenAI’s API when an AI-based response or translation is requested. The data is only sent when a user initiates an action that requires AI interaction.

Service used: OpenAI (https://openai.com)
– Endpoint used: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions
– Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
– Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

No personal or identifying data is sent unless explicitly included by the user in their request. You should review OpenAI’s terms and privacy policy before use.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/eca-translator-lite/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to “EcaTranslator Lite” settings in your WordPress admin to configure and start translating your content.
sections.faq:
How many languages can I add?

You can add unlimited languages. The Lite version supports basic translation; Pro version offers advanced features.

short_description: Easily translate your WordPress posts and pages into multiple languages. Simple, fast, and works seamlessly with popular page builders.
